author: Subscriptor
body:
Well, I think the time has came to make it, since no staff or anyone has made it yet.
In this thread, you should orginize all your feedbacks from all different posts and about different topics that can help the server succeed, in a mature, nice way, right down below.
I suggest you putting your feedback in the format below:

Server Feedback:

Staff: 

Players:

Server:

Website:

Teamspeak:

Events:

Maps:

Other:

My personal feedback is:

Staff: You're doing a great job, but most of the time you can't admit you're doing something wrong, some of you are also really hard to give constructive criticism and you just hide what you are doing wrong insteaf of facing it in a mature way, and dealing with the issue in the right way, and trying to improve. Also the team is a bit biased. I will explain how it's biased if needed. When the community says you're doing something wrong, admit it, but don't take your actions back, you need to take responsibility about every step you do, and think twice before performing an action like a demotion, think about what it could lead to, is it right? etc. Sometimes staff give wrong information about some topics so I suggest you to talk with a Senior Mod or higher before posting some information that could lead to confusion.  Also on scrim servers some rules aren't enforced so the staff are being really rude and it dissapoints me, since they are supposed to set players example of how to behave even if the rules aren't enforeced. Just few ideas.

Players: As a player myself I know how it usually goes, once staff does a mistake  all community goes and starts a huge flame war which usually isn't even about the actual topic, it goes completely off topic and very rude. I think we should respect the staff, because in the end of the day, the staff are here for us, and they are staff because they want the server to improve, and we are kind of supposed to tell them how to improve in a mature way and not in a flame war or something, Overal the staff-players communication needs to improve. 

Server: The server is pretty good, though the gameplay is pretty laggy, which prevents most of the players to enjoy the game, and no, it's not a ping issue. You need to fix the lag, and I know you're working on it and it's not that easy to fix lag, however the block lag has been fixed before so I am pretty sure it won't be too hard to fix. Also, Avicus has pretty much really biased knockback, and several people with better ping are pretty much undefeatable. I myself don't really know how to fix it or think about something, but if you developers know how to, go for it. Other than those stuff in my opinion the server is good.

Website: The website itself is good, I don't really find something that needs to be added or removed, maybe just a little glitch or bug, whatever, when you go on user's profile page, for example it shows on the screen you're on the about page, and you're actually on the infractions or stats page, which makes you click more than 4 times on a section to get on it, though it happens only in profile pages so the website and forums are great. Also sometimes the forums are not loading with the message "Heavy load, try again later", so if you can fix it, it will be great.

Teamspeak: In all honesty, I think TeamSpeak is the most orginized service Avicus provides. It's very orginized, in my opinion its 100% great, just leave it like that.

Events: I know it was the first tourney, but we can still suggest. First, before the tourney, in the tourney map testing, only one team showed up, which is our fault, but in case that happens I think you should've orginized one more testing to prevent stuff like what happened with operation D which got removed in middle of the tourney because of glitches. Also, state clearly everything and all info about the tourney, make a big post about the tourney and give permission to everybody to ask questions below, try to be more orginized. 

Maps: Some maps are really good and have good gameplay, but sometimes the map developers accept maps with poor gameplay which you can see, in my opinion maps accepting needs to be like staff application, you accept a map only if it looks really good to you, and not to give a chance in testing and then improve the map, tell what to improve in the map before you test it, and be sure to keep up the good work, because you're pretty much the most orginized team in the whole staff, and you listen well to the community.

Other: A public build server would be nice. I mean, people that send maps regulary and help with building should apply for a trusted rank, and be able to go on a server, /server Build, which they will get a world for them, and be able to build. In case one of the players breaks the rules which are most likely not griefing, crashing, etc, will get his trusted rank revoked, and will need to apply again. Also make the whole server 1.8 because the current situation prevents fair gameplay, causes more lag, and prevents map builders use 1.8 blocks which are useful and good, in their maps. Also I don't see putting advertisement in the priority above fixing server lag as a smart action, because new players will come and won't enjoy the gameplay which won't make them stay. Therefore you should fix the bugs, lags, and glitches, and then advertise.

Remember, this thread is actual thread to make the server better, and you need to not turn it into a flame war and go completely off topic on every other thread, this one is supposed to actually make the server better by orginizing all community opinions with staff opinions, which will lead to conclusions, and hopefully take right actions, and make this server succeed. Leave your feedback right down below.

title: Avicus » General Feedback Thread

replies.author: Tynvale
replies.body:
+1 to the post, I agree 100% with your points Eric but I want to add my own opinions.

Staff: I honestly don't know how I feel about the staff, I guess I am 50/50. Everyone in the staff team seems like nice people but there are some decisions they make that I and sometimes others don't agree with. There has to be a reason why tons of staff are retiring and or getting demoted and I think that the whole system needs to be looked at again and should maybe even allow some input from the community.

Players: The players on Avicus vary, a lot of the regulars follow the rules and are really nice people. But when a decision from the staff goes wrong a flame war starts and everything gets blown out of proportion. All this could be fixed if both players and staff communicated better, maybe there could be a 'communications manager' or something to fit the role.

Server: I love this server, and if I didn't I would have left by now. The main issue I have with it though is that the lag needs to be fixed. If we want to grow and compete against other big servers it needs to improve. Once this is better I think we can start worrying about promoting and advertising the server with Youtubers and similar platforms.

Website: The website I find really good, yes there are some bugs here and there but if those are fixed it would be perfect. My main issue with the website is the posts made and how the staff handle them.

Teamspeak: As well as the website, teamspeak is great, I don't think any major improvements are needed. As Eric said it is probably the most organised part of the server.

Events: Other than me being involved with the media side of it I can't really say much about my opinions on it. I do like the forum ranks for the winners though. As well as my media rank!

Maps: The majority of the maps we have look great, but a lot don't play great. It seems like the map devs are focusing on looks instead of gameplay. The McZone maps are like the opposite of what is going on now, they play well but don't look nice. I think people also have to realise that adding aesthetics to a map can actually change it's gameplay as well as it's look.

replies.author: BmB
replies.body:
I wrote this on my AMA but i thought it would be fitting for here 

The staff need to freaking sort their shit out omg everyone's like an 8 year old drama queen running round looking for sympathy and trying to put each other down in some stupid revenge act, get a grip. I think all of the staff problems just come from the seniors and people who dealt with the applications to take more time, i remember about a year ago that the staff had far less problems and was run better as well as not accepting almost every single mod applicant, be harsher and more selective to get better results. Avicus' only real hope of attracting players and keeping the server interesting is it's tournaments so spend more time and effort on that would be a good thing to do.
